known.title: Security: Pass the row text as a literal shell argument
Follow-up: Preserve light-review names in a story’s saved title

findings.body:
Gain 5, Work 2, Harm 4
Raise: Security
Case: normal use - a coordinator starts work on a contributed “Demo only” file.
`src/forge/gaps.py:44-47` inserts tracked filenames directly into the row’s Say text. A filename such as `apps/web/src/$(id).tsx` therefore reaches the double-quoted shell command prescribed here, where command substitution runs before `forge start` receives the argument. A contributor who controls a filename can execute commands on the coordinator’s machine. Pass the text as a literal argument, with shell-appropriate escaping.
Adds work: safely quote the row text; F 1 x H 3 = 3; 2 x C = 2.
findings.title: Security: Pass the row text as a literal shell argument

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - the light-review list includes a prototype documentation fix, and the follow-up changes only documentation that tests do not read.
The guide promises that a normal change receives a full review and clears the named gap. But `src/forge/review.py:178-186` assigns a documentation-only change a P0-only review even after sign-off, and `src/forge/gaps.py:80-83` does not count such a fix toward clearing the gap. Following the guide therefore leaves the line open and the coordinator unable to proceed with release preparation without an owner waiver. Provide a supported qualifying review or explicit handling for this case.
findings.title: Functional: Handle documentation-only light-review gaps

findings.body:
Gain 2, Work 1, Harm 2
Case: normal use - `forge start` chooses a story and its plan names the reviewed parts, but its shorter title does not.
The guide says to keep the names in the change’s text, but `src/forge/gaps.py:84-92` checks only the saved story title. `src/forge/intake.py:35-38` and `src/forge/intake.py:124-138` let the intake response put names in the plan independently of its title. Thus a completed story can follow the guidance and still leave the gap open. Specify that the saved story title must contain the names.
Adds work: verify the names in the saved title; F 2 x H 2 = 4; 2 x C = 2.
findings.title: Follow-up: Preserve light-review names in a story’s saved title
